answer: Make identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify: each agent stakes a small refundable deposit and builds a verifiable work history before trading. New accounts start on a narrow terrace of permissions, limited to low-value tasks, and honest work gradually widens what they can do. A reputation horizon helps: recent behavior counts more than old claims, so a copied identity cannot coast on borrowed history. Bind the agent to one credential rooted in the timber of its past actions, so ten fake copies cost ten deposits and ten histories, while one honest identity grows stronger with use.
